title: षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Duryodhana comes forward as Bhima approaches, and they circle each other with raised maces. In the fight Duryodhana strikes Bhima with his club until blood runs, and Bhima's retort shakes the earth.
summary.kn: ಭೀಮ ಸಮೀಪಿಸಿದಾಗ ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಮುನ್ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಗದೆ ಎತ್ತಿ ಒಬ್ಬರ ಸುತ್ತ ಒಬ್ಬರು ಸುತ್ತುತ್ತಾರೆ. ದುರ್ಯೋಧನ ಗದೆಯಿಂದ ಭೀಮನನ್ನು ರಕ್ತ ಹರಿಯುವವರೆಗೆ ಹೊಡೆಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮನ ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೊಡೆತ ಭೂಮಿ ಕಂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: भीम के निकट आने पर दुर्योधन आगे आता है और दोनों गदाएँ उठाए एक-दूसरे के चारों ओर घूमते हैं। दुर्योधन गदा से भीम को रक्त बहने तक मारता है, और भीम का प्रतिउत्तर पृथ्वी हिला देता है।
summary.te: భీముడు సమీపించగా దుర్యోధనుడు ముందుకు వస్తాడు; గదలు ఎత్తి ఒకరి చుట్టూ ఒకరు తిరుగుతారు. దుర్యోధనుడు గదతో భీముని రక్తం కారే వరకు కొడతాడు; భీముని ప్రతిదెబ్బ భూమిని కంపింపజేస్తుంది.
summary.ta: பீமன் நெருங்க, துரியோதனன் முன்வருகிறான்; கதைகளை உயர்த்தி இருவரும் ஒருவரைச் சுற்றி ஒருவர் வருகின்றனர். துரியோதனன் கதையால் பீமனை இரத்தம் வழியும்வரை அடிக்க, பீமனின் பதிலடி பூமியை அதிரச்செய்கிறது.
summary.ml: ഭീമൻ അടുത്തെത്തുമ്പോൾ ദുര്യോധനൻ മുന്നോട്ടു വരുന്നു; ഇരുവരും ഗദകളുയർത്തി പരസ്പരം വലംവയ്ക്കുന്നു. യുദ്ധത്തിൽ രക്തമൊഴുകുന്നതുവരെ ദുര്യോധനൻ ഭീമനെ ഗദകൊണ്ട് പ്രഹരിക്കുന്നു; ഭീമന്റെ മറുപടി ഭൂമിയെ വിറപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 9.56; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jun 23 2020

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततो दुर्योधनो दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनं तथागतम् ।
प्रत्युद्ययावदीनात्मा वेगेन महता नदन् ॥

meaning.en: Then Duryodhana, seeing Bhimasena arrive, advanced to meet him with undimmed spirit, roaring with great force.

verses.text:
समापेततुरानद्य शृङ्गिणौ वृषभाविव ।
महानिर्घातघोषश्च संप्रहारस्तयोरभूत् ॥

meaning.en: They rushed together like two horned bulls, and the clash between them made a great sound like thunder.

verses.text:
अभवच्च तयोर्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् ।
जिगीषतोर्युधान्योन्यमिन्द्रप्रह्रादयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: A tumultuous, hair-raising fight arose between them, each eager to beat the other, like that of Indra and Prahlada.

verses.text:
रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गौ गदाहस्तौ मनस्विनौ ।
ददृशाते महात्मानौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ॥

meaning.en: Their whole bodies drenched in blood, those two great-souled, spirited men, mace in hand, looked like two flowering kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
तथा तस्मिन्महायुद्धे वर्तमाने सुदारुणे ।
खद्योतसंघैरिव खं दर्शनीयं व्यरोचत ॥

meaning.en: As that fearsome great battle went on, the sky looked lovely, shining as though with swarms of fireflies.

verses.text:
तथा तस्मिन्वर्तमाने संकुले तुमुले भृशम् ।
उभावपि परिश्रान्तौ युध्यमानावरिंदमौ ॥

meaning.en: As that crowded and violent fight continued, both those subduers of enemies grew weary as they fought.

verses.text:
तौ मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्य पुनरेव परंतपौ ।
अभ्यहारयतां तत्र संप्रगृह्य गदे शुभे ॥

meaning.en: Those two scorchers of foes, after resting a moment, raised their splendid maces and attacked each other again.

verses.text:
तौ तु दृष्ट्वा महावीर्यौ समाश्वस्तौ नरर्षभौ ।
बलिनौ वारणौ यद्वद्वाशितार्थे मदोत्कटौ ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those two mighty bulls among men refreshed, like two strong elephants in musk-frenzy over a female elephant,

verses.text:
अपारवीर्यौ संप्रेक्ष्य प्रगृहीतगदावुभौ ।
विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः ॥

meaning.en: the gods, gandharvas and danavas, seeing both of boundless prowess holding their maces ready, were filled with great wonder.

verses.text:
प्रगृहीतगदौ दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ ।
संशयः सर्वभूतानां विजये समपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Duryodhana and Vrikodara with maces raised, all beings were in doubt about who would win.

verses.text:
समागम्य ततो भूयो भ्रातरौ बलिनां वरौ ।
अन्योन्यस्यान्तरप्रेप्सू प्रचक्रातेऽन्तरं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: The two brothers, best of the strong, closed in again, each seeking an opening against the other.

verses.text:
यमदण्डोपमां गुर्वीमिन्द्राशनिमिवोद्यताम् ।
ददृशुः प्रेक्षका राजन्रौद्रीं विशसनीं गदाम् ॥

meaning.en: The onlookers saw, O king, the terrible, heavy, crushing mace, like Yama's rod or Indra's thunderbolt raised on high.

verses.text:
आविध्यतो गदां तस्य भीमसेनस्य संयुगे ।
शब्दः सुतुमुलो घोरो मुहूर्तं समपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: As Bhimasena whirled his mace in the battle, a very loud and fearful sound arose for a moment.

verses.text:
आविध्यन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य धार्तराष्ट्रोऽथ पाण्डवम् ।
गदामलघुवेगां तां विस्मितः संबभूव ह ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the Pandava whirl that mace with no slight force, Dhritarashtra's son was amazed.

verses.text:
चरंश्च विविधान्मार्गान्मण्डलानि च भारत ।
अशोभत तदा वीरो भूय एव वृकोदरः ॥

meaning.en: Moving along many paths and circling, O Bharata, the hero Vrikodara looked more splendid still.

verses.text:
तौ परस्परमासाद्य यत्तावन्योन्यरक्षणे ।
मार्जाराविव भक्षार्थे ततक्षाते मुहुर्मुहुः ॥

meaning.en: Coming at each other, each guarding himself carefully, they struck repeatedly, again and again, like two cats after food.

verses.text:
अचरद्भीमसेनस्तु मार्गान्बहुविधांस्तथा ।
मण्डलानि विचित्राणि स्थानानि विविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena moved along many kinds of paths, in varied circling movements and varied stances,

verses.text:
गोमूत्रिकाणि चित्राणि गतप्रत्यागतानि च ।
परिमोक्षं प्रहाराणां वर्जनं परिधावनम् ॥

meaning.en: in zigzag movements, forward and back, releasing blows, avoiding them, running around,

verses.text:
अभिद्रवणमाक्षेपमवस्थानं सविग्रहम् ।
परावर्तनसंवर्तमवप्लुतमथाप्लुतम् ।
उपन्यस्तमपन्यस्तं गदायुद्धविशारदौ ॥

meaning.en: attacking, striking out, holding ground, closing in, turning away, wheeling, leaping over and leaping up, putting down and taking back the mace, both being masters of mace fighting.

verses.text:
एवं तौ विचरन्तौ तु न्यघ्नतां वै परस्परम् ।
वञ्चयन्तौ पुनश्चैव चेरतुः कुरुसत्तमौ ॥

meaning.en: Moving so, they struck each other and again deceived each other, those two best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
विक्रीडन्तौ सुबलिनौ मण्डलानि प्रचेरतुः ।
गदाहस्तौ ततस्तौ तु मण्डलावस्थितौ बली ॥

meaning.en: Playing, both very strong, they moved in circles, and, mace in hand, they stood firm in their circling positions.

verses.text:
दक्षिणं मण्डलं राजन्धार्तराष्ट्रोऽभ्यवर्तत ।
सव्यं तु मण्डलं तत्र भीमसेनोऽभ्यवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana moved in a right-hand circle, O king, while Bhimasena moved in the left-hand circle.

verses.text:
तथा तु चरतस्तस्य भीमस्य रणमूर्धनि ।
दुर्योधनो महाराज पार्श्वदेशेऽभ्यताडयत् ॥

meaning.en: As Bhima moved so at the head of the battle, O great king, Duryodhana struck him in the side.

verses.text:
आहतस्तु तदा भीमस्तव पुत्रेण भारत ।
आविध्यत गदां गुर्वीं प्रहारं तमचिन्तयन् ॥

meaning.en: Struck then by your son, O Bharata, Bhima paid no heed to the blow and whirled his heavy mace.

verses.text:
इन्द्राशनिसमां घोरां यमदण्डमिवोद्यताम् ।
ददृशुस्ते महाराज भीमसेनस्य तां गदाम् ॥

meaning.en: They saw Bhimasena's mace, terrible like Indra's bolt, raised like Yama's rod, O great king.

verses.text:
आविध्यन्तं गदां दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनं तवात्मजः ।
समुद्यम्य गदां घोरां प्रत्यविध्यदरिंदमः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhimasena whirling his mace, your son, subduer of enemies, raised his fearsome mace and whirled it in answer.

verses.text:
गदामारुतवेगेन तव पुत्रस्य भारत ।
शब्द आसीत्सुतुमुलस्तेजश्च समजायत ॥

meaning.en: From the rushing wind of your son's mace, O Bharata, there was a very tumultuous sound, and a glow came up.

verses.text:
स चरन्विविधान्मार्गान्मण्डलानि च भागशः ।
समशोभत तेजस्वी भूयो भीमात्सुयोधनः ॥

meaning.en: Moving along various paths and circles in turn, the radiant Suyodhana looked even more splendid than Bhima.

verses.text:
आविद्धा सर्ववेगेन भीमेन महती गदा ।
सधूमं सार्चिषं चाग्निं मुमोचोग्रा महास्वना ॥

meaning.en: Whirled with all his speed by Bhima, the great mace, fierce and loud, threw off fire with smoke and flame.

verses.text:
आधूतां भीमसेनेन गदां दृष्ट्वा सुयोधनः ।
अद्रिसारमयीं गुर्वीमाविध्यन्बह्वशोभत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the mace whirled by Bhimasena, Suyodhana whirled his own heavy mace of iron from the mountains, and looked magnificent.

verses.text:
गदामारुतवेगं हि दृष्ट्वा तस्य महात्मनः ।
भयं विवेश पाण्डून्वै सर्वानेव ससोमकान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing the wind-rush of that great-souled man's mace, fear entered all the Pandavas along with the Somakas.

verses.text:
तौ दर्शयन्तौ समरे युद्धक्रीडां समन्ततः ।
गदाभ्यां सहसान्योन्यमाजघ्नतुररिंदमौ ॥

meaning.en: Showing each other in the fight the sport of mace combat on every side, those two subduers of enemies suddenly struck each other with their maces.

verses.text:
तौ परस्परमासाद्य दंष्ट्राभ्यां द्विरदौ यथा ।
अशोभेतां महाराज शोणितेन परिप्लुतौ ॥

meaning.en: Closing on each other like two elephants with tusks, those two shone, O great king, drenched in blood.

verses.text:
एवं तदभवद्युद्धं घोररूपमसंवृतम् ।
परिवृत्तेऽहनि क्रूरं वृत्रवासवयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: So that terrible, unrestrained battle went on, fierce, as the day wore on, like that of Vritra and Indra.

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा व्यवस्थितं भीमं तव पुत्रो महाबलः ।
चरंश्चित्रतरान्मार्गान्कौन्तेयमभिदुद्रुवे ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhima steady, your mighty son, moving along stranger paths, rushed at the son of Kunti.

verses.text:
तस्य भीमो महावेगां जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृताम् ।
अभिक्रुद्धस्य क्रुद्धस्तु ताडयामास तां गदाम् ॥

meaning.en: Bhima, angry, struck with his own mace the gold-decked mace of the furious Duryodhana, which came with great speed.

verses.text:
सविस्फुलिङ्गो निर्ह्रादस्तयोस्तत्राभिघातजः ।
प्रादुरासीन्महाराज सृष्टयोर्वज्रयोरिव ॥

meaning.en: From the clash of those two, sparks flew and a roar arose, O great king, like two thunderbolts let loose.

verses.text:
वेगवत्या तया तत्र भीमसेनप्रमुक्तया ।
निपतन्त्या महाराज पृथिवी समकम्पत ॥

meaning.en: As that swift mace, flung by Bhimasena, fell, the earth shook, O great king.

verses.text:
तां नामृष्यत कौरव्यो गदां प्रतिहतां रणे ।
मत्तो द्विप इव क्रुद्धः प्रतिकुञ्जरदर्शनात् ॥

meaning.en: The Kaurava could not bear that his mace had been struck back in battle, like a rutting elephant angry at the sight of a rival elephant.

verses.text:
स सव्यं मण्डलं राजन्नुद्भ्राम्य कृतनिश्चयः ।
आजघ्ने मूर्ध्नि कौन्तेयं गदया भीमवेगया ॥

meaning.en: Whirling in a left-hand circle, O king, with firm resolve he struck the son of Kunti on the head with a mace driven with terrible force.

verses.text:
तया त्वभिहतो भीमः पुत्रेण तव पाण्डवः ।
नाकम्पत महाराज तदद्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Struck by your son with that mace, Bhima, the Pandava, did not tremble, O great king; it seemed a marvel.

verses.text:
आश्चर्यं चापि तद्राजन्सर्वसैन्यान्यपूजयन् ।
यद्गदाभिहतो भीमो नाकम्पत पदात्पदम् ॥

meaning.en: O king, all the armies praised it as a wonder that Bhima, struck by the mace, did not move a single step.

verses.text:
ततो गुरुतरां दीप्तां गदां हेमपरिष्कृताम् ।
दुर्योधनाय व्यसृजद्भीमो भीमपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, of terrible prowess, hurled a heavier, blazing mace, decked with gold, at Duryodhana.

verses.text:
तं प्रहारमसंभ्रान्तो लाघवेन महाबलः ।
मोघं दुर्योधनश्चक्रे तत्राभूद्विस्मयो महान् ॥

meaning.en: Calm and very strong, Duryodhana made that blow miss by his agility, and there was great amazement.

verses.text:
सा तु मोघा गदा राजन्पतन्ती भीमचोदिता ।
चालयामास पृथिवीं महानिर्घातनिस्वना ॥

meaning.en: That missed mace, O king, falling at Bhima's throw, made the earth tremble with a great sound like thunder.

verses.text:
आस्थाय कौशिकान्मार्गानुत्पतन्स पुनः पुनः ।
गदानिपातं प्रज्ञाय भीमसेनमवञ्चयत् ॥

meaning.en: Using the Kaushika movements and leaping up again and again, Duryodhana, judging the fall of the mace, evaded Bhimasena.

verses.text:
वञ्चयित्वा तथा भीमं गदया कुरुसत्तमः ।
ताडयामास संक्रुद्धो वक्षोदेशे महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Having evaded Bhima so, the strong best of the Kurus, furious, struck him with his mace on the chest.

verses.text:
गदयाभिहतो भीमो मुह्यमानो महारणे ।
नाभ्यमन्यत कर्तव्यं पुत्रेणाभ्याहतस्तव ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the mace, Bhima, dazed in the great battle, did not know what he should do, hit by your son.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने राजन्सोमकपाण्डवाः ।
भृशोपहतसंकल्पा नहृष्टमनसोऽभवन् ॥

meaning.en: While this went on, O king, the Somakas and Pandavas lost heart, their resolve badly shaken, and were not glad.

verses.text:
स तु तेन प्रहारेण मातङ्ग इव रोषितः ।
हस्तिवद्धस्तिसंकाशमभिदुद्राव ते सुतम् ॥

meaning.en: But Bhima, enraged by that blow like an elephant, rushed like an elephant at your son, who resembled one.

verses.text:
ततस्तु रभसो भीमो गदया तनयं तव ।
अभिदुद्राव वेगेन सिंहो वनगजं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Then swift Bhima rushed with his mace at your son, quickly, like a lion at a forest elephant.

verses.text:
उपसृत्य तु राजानं गदामोक्षविशारदः ।
आविध्यत गदां राजन्समुद्दिश्य सुतं तव ॥

meaning.en: Going up to the king, expert in releasing the mace, he whirled it, O king, aiming at your son.

verses.text:
अताडयद्भीमसेनः पार्श्वे दुर्योधनं तदा ।
स विह्वलः प्रहारेण जानुभ्यामगमन्महीम् ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena then struck Duryodhana in the side; overcome by the blow, Duryodhana fell to his knees on the ground.

verses.text:
तस्मिंस्तु भरतश्रेष्ठे जानुभ्यामवनीं गते ।
उदतिष्ठत्ततो नादः सृञ्जयानां जगत्पते ॥

meaning.en: When that best of the Bharatas had gone down on his knees, a shout rose up from the Srinjayas, O lord of the world.

verses.text:
तेषां तु निनदं श्रुत्वा सृञ्जयानां नरर्षभः ।
अमर्षाद्भरतश्रेष्ठ पुत्रस्ते समकुप्यत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the roar of the Srinjayas, your son, the bull among men, was furious with anger, O best of Bharatas.

verses.text:
उत्थाय तु महाबाहुः क्रुद्धो नाग इव श्वसन् ।
दिधक्षन्निव नेत्राभ्यां भीमसेनमवैक्षत ॥

meaning.en: The mighty-armed man rose, hissing like an angry snake, and looked at Bhimasena as though to burn him with his eyes.

verses.text:
ततः स भरतश्रेष्ठो गदापाणिरभिद्रवत् ।
प्रमथिष्यन्निव शिरो भीमसेनस्य संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: Then that best of the Bharatas, mace in hand, charged, as if to crush Bhimasena's head in the battle.

verses.text:
स महात्मा महात्मानं भीमं भीमपराक्रमः ।
अताडयच्छङ्खदेशे स चचालाचलोपमः ॥

meaning.en: That great-souled man of terrible prowess struck the great-souled Bhima on the temple, and Bhima, like a mountain, swayed.

verses.text:
स भूयः शुशुभे पार्थस्ताडितो गदया रणे ।
उद्भिन्नरुधिरो राजन्प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by the mace in battle, the son of Pritha looked splendid again, O king, bleeding profusely like an elephant in musk.

verses.text:
ततो गदां वीरहणीमयस्मयीं
प्रगृह्य वज्राशनितुल्यनिस्वनाम् ।
अताडयच्छत्रुममित्रकर्शनो
बलेन विक्रम्य धनंजयाग्रजः ॥

meaning.en: Then the elder brother of Dhananjaya, the tormentor of his enemies, took up his iron mace, a slayer of heroes, sounding like thunderbolt and lightning, and, using his strength and valour, struck his foe.

verses.text:
स भीमसेनाभिहतस्तवात्मजः
पपात संकम्पितदेहबन्धनः ।
सुपुष्पितो मारुतवेगताडितो
महावने साल इवावघूर्णितः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by Bhimasena, your son fell, his frame trembling, like a tall flowering sala tree in a great forest struck by the force of the wind, spinning.

verses.text:
ततः प्रणेदुर्जहृषुश्च पाण्डवाः
समीक्ष्य पुत्रं पतितं क्षितौ तव ।
ततः सुतस्ते प्रतिलभ्य चेतनां
समुत्पपात द्विरदो यथा ह्रदात् ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandavas roared and rejoiced at seeing your son fallen on the ground; but your son regained his senses and sprang up like an elephant from a lake.

verses.text:
स पार्थिवो नित्यममर्षितस्तदा
महारथः शिक्षितवत्परिभ्रमन् ।
अताडयत्पाण्डवमग्रतः स्थितं
स विह्वलाङ्गो जगतीमुपास्पृशत् ॥

meaning.en: That king, always angry, a great chariot-warrior, whirling around as one trained, struck the Pandava standing in front of him, and Bhima, his limbs dazed, touched the ground.

verses.text:
स सिंहनादान्विननाद कौरवो
निपात्य भूमौ युधि भीममोजसा ।
बिभेद चैवाशनितुल्यतेजसा
गदानिपातेन शरीररक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: The Kaurava roared lion-roars, having felled Bhima to the ground in battle by force, and with the fall of his mace, bright as lightning, he broke the armour that guarded Bhima's body.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्तरिक्षे निनदो महानभू-
द्दिवौकसामप्सरसां च नेदुषाम् ।
पपात चोच्चैरमरप्रवेरितं
विचित्रपुष्पोत्करवर्षमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then a great noise arose in the sky from the gods and the singing apsaras, and a splendid shower of heaps of many-coloured flowers, sent by the gods, fell from above.

verses.text:
ततः परानाविशदुत्तमं भयं
समीक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं नरोत्तमम् ।
अहीयमानं च बलेन कौरवं
निशम्य भेदं च दृढस्य वर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: Then great fear entered the enemy, seeing the best of men fallen on the ground, and the Kaurava undiminished in strength, and hearing that the strong armour had been broken.

verses.text:
ततो मुहूर्तादुपलभ्य चेतनां
प्रमृज्य वक्त्रं रुधिरार्द्रमात्मनः ।
धृतिं समालम्ब्य विवृत्तलोचनो
बलेन संस्तभ्य वृकोदरः स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Then, after a moment, Vrikodara regained his senses, wiped his blood-wet face, took courage, and, with rolling eyes, steadied himself by his strength and stood.
